overloads.semanticRole: Asynchronously queues execution of methodName (with the given parameters) on the named registered 4D Client, running in a process automatically created on that client workstation.

constraints: clientName must be a name previously registered via REGISTER CLIENT.
Pass the wildcard character '@' in clientName to execute the method simultaneously on multiple or all registered 4D Clients.
Repeated calls targeting the same client are queued and executed one after another in asynchronous order (not interrupted or cancelable except by unregistering the client with UNREGISTER CLIENT).
